subject.title: fix(gateway): fail fast on missing local probe auth

question: Should unresolved configured local gateway credentials stop status probing by default, or should status retain the shipped probe behavior while reporting the credential-resolution diagnostic?
rationale: Both outcomes are technically implementable, but choosing between a fail-closed status result and backward-compatible probing changes operator-facing gateway semantics and cannot be settled from tests alone.

options.title: Preserve the current probe default
options.body: Keep attempting the local probe and attach the actionable unresolved-credential diagnostic so existing status and recovery workflows continue to receive probe results.

options.title: Adopt fail-fast intentionally
options.body: Accept the new default, document the changed operator behavior, and add focused compatibility coverage proving the intended upgrade path and paired-device exceptions.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Close or defer the PR if neither status semantic has owner sponsorship at this time.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current probe default
recommendation.body: Keep attempting the local probe and attach the actionable unresolved-credential diagnostic so existing status and recovery workflows continue to receive probe results.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR timeline explicitly routes the gateway/auth discussion to this person; broader ownership history could not be read in the restricted environment.
